summary: Checked all 39 estimates against the supplied 54-page April 2025 NBER working paper. Read the entire markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-C, and extracted every estimate-source PDF page with pymupdf. Inspected the relevant figures in memory and independently matched all recorded numeric statistics, significance bounds, pairwise p-values, and arm counts to the PDF tables. The numeric transcriptions match. Found two omissions: the printed study randomization total and one qualitative solution-balance contrast in the discussion. The paper itself has inconsistent participant totals, already documented in the extraction; no replacement total was calculated. Other estimate coding and exclusions were supported by the paper and codebook.
